canvas.coordinates: zero-indexed, x right and y down
canvas.other_facing: Verify mirrored master, muzzle socket and effect origin. Redraw visible asymmetric details if needed.
canvas.wider_cells: Pad on both sides as needed while preserving the foot line and corresponding horizontal pivot.

body.notes: First frame is the native draft preview. Low diagonal carry.
Coordinate playback rate with native movement. No local translation of the foot anchor.
Attack interval stays separate from the pose duration.
One release path per attack. Verify selection through the existing attack presentation before locking frame alignment.
Blend into the current native idle or run pose with the attached concealment presentation.
Optional appearance transition. Active attack or death can take over immediately.
Visual hop rides supported native displacement. Pin cone origin and facing at the actual release.
Lower to a low asymmetric brace. The first round releases after this windup.
Neutral aim pose used between recoil pulses or when waiting for an event.
Start on each resolved release. Eighteen ticks of recoil leave three ticks of hold before the next scheduled shot.
Start after final recoil or a normal cancel. Native hit and death take priority.
End on native removal. Never hold the death pose through the respawn countdown.

ultimate_timing.cancel: End the lock and pending rounds when the cast terminates. If grenade cancellation is implemented, release one final round before dropping the pending sequence.
ultimate_timing.interception: A round's impact is tied to its first resolved champion contact, which may be the blocker. The lock cue follows the intended target until the cast terminates.
ultimate_timing.cleanup: Remove attached presentation on cancellation, state exit or death. An already-fired projectile follows its own impact or expiry lifecycle.

notes: Frame timings are for original TFM2 art and event alignment. The skill footage timecodes live in the atlas.
Event names identify production cues, not existing SDK callbacks. Validate the corresponding native bindings before integration.
Export actual muzzle coordinates for release poses. The owner art determines exact sockets.
A native visible idle must exist for draft. Use the actual body pose for concealment and prioritize native hit and dead.
